prompt:
Design the signature (authored) arts of one family of the art library: Earth (Thổ): endurance, weight, block and Earth stacks, slow heavy payoffs. About 7 arts.

Read by section only (Grep '^## ' / '^### ' for headings, then read the range):
- design/arts/README.md, and the existing arts of this family in design/arts/part-a.json, part-b.json, part-c.json (Grep for the element or form; treat the `authored` ones as raw ideas to improve or replace, keep the `common` ones as they are and do not repeat them);
- .claude/skills/design-build/references/content-formats.md § Fight input (the Effect schema, art fields, states, actions, mod keys, readables);
- design/gdd/effects.md rule 9a (element stacks) and § Status Catalogue; rule 16 (extended rules) if useful.

What a signature art is:
- ONE distinctive mechanic a player can name and build around, written in the engine schema (effects, counters, states, charges, convert, split, hp_cost, statuses, buff/debuff, guards). Examples of the bar: 'Rising Tide Palm: each firing adds a Tide (counter, no cap); at 5 Tide the next firing becomes 5 waves (split) and spends them'; 'Ashfall Stance: a stance (state) where your basic attack converts half to Fire and lays Burn, but your other Fire arts are suppressed'; 'Debt Blade: costs health instead of linh lực (hp_cost), and deals more the lower your health'; 'Echoing Peal: every 3rd crit fires your last Thunder art again at half (fire_art)'.
- Mechanic shapes to spread across the family (no two arts in the family share a shape): charges and bursts; build-up then cash-in (counter, consume); stances and forms; conversion; paying with health or a second pool; conditional payoffs (low health, foe dry, stacks above N); echoes and repeats; summons; split hits; delays and Slowed Time; curse patterns; healing or shields as a weapon; held payloads ('your next art').
- Each art lists `hooks`: what a build scales on it (e.g. ['crit', 'fire stacks', 'art speed', 'low health', 'charges']). Scaling is limitless unless the art states its own cap. Avoid plain '+X damage if Y' unless the condition itself is the identity.
- Numbers pass the lint: c_art at or under the art lint after its stack and curse charge; cost_share 0.02-0.125; cooldown 0.5-12 s.

Write design/arts/family-earth.json: a JSON list of art objects with id, name ('English (Hán-Việt)'), element ('' for element-less), role (damage, stacks, curse, heal, ward, soul, utility, control, summon), tier 'authored', tags (forms such as sword, palm, song, seal; plus quick or heavy), the art numbers and mechanic fields, `rule` (two plain sentences a player reads), `hooks`, and `sources` (library or staged ids it replaces, if any). Then run `python -I tools/design/arts/lint_arts.py design/arts/family-earth.json` and fix every finding until it prints 0 findings.
Write design/arts/family-earth.md: a table | Art | Mechanic shape | Hooks | One-line rule |, which library arts it replaces, and anything the engine could not express (name the missing piece).
End your final message with: FAMILY-DONE design/arts/family-earth.json
